title: Recreational Services Branch – Approval of a Gift Agreement for a Donation
text:
Recreational Services Branch – Approval of a Gift Agreement for a Donation
  Consisting of an Atlas Stretch Tent and Modular Shade Structure from the
  University of Southern California under the ShadeLA Program for Use at
  Various RAP-Sponsored Events and Programs throughout the City
summary: Accepts a donation from the University of Southern California of a stretch tent and modular shade structure for use at Recreation and Parks events and programs citywide.
